rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; healthy-base group drawn from 11 sites (sites 2, 3, 10, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 22, 24) with multiple scanners (Philips Achieva, Siemens Magnetom Symphony, Siemens Tim Trio, GE Excite 1.5T, Siemens Verio, GE Signa, Philips Gyroscan Achieva)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research, and the data were collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR)."
rci1_using_msad.location: Lin2023.pdf.md: 2.1. Participants, L81; 1-s2.0-S0165032723001271-mmc1.docx.md: Table S1 Healthy-base group

rci2_using_epd.detail: Data sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium via International Big-Data Center for Depression Research (IBCDR); Yan et al. 2019 PNAS is the REST-meta-MDD dataset paper
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We employed data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research, and the data were collected from multiple hospitals/institutions in China (http://yanlab.psych.ac.cn/IBCDR). Full details on the datasets and preprocessing pipeline have been described previously (Yan et al., 2019)."

rci3_epd_name.detail: IBCDR data described in Yan et al. 2019 (PNAS), which is the REST-meta-MDD consortium; also confirmed by Long et al. 2020 reference citing REST-meta-MDD consortium using the same data source
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Full details on the datasets and preprocessing pipeline have been described previously (Yan et al., 2019)." ; Yan et al., 2019: "Reduced default mode network functional connectivity in patients with recurrent major depressive disorder. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences"

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; healthy-base group (289 HC) used to establish the normative model via quantile polynomial regression
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Another 289 healthy control individuals (165 female, as a healthy-base group) of 832 controls were included to establish a normative model"

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; female_n directly reported; male_n estimated from total N (289) minus reported female_n (165)
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "Another 289 healthy control individuals (165 female, as a healthy-base group)" ; Table 1: N=289, Gender(female)=165

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; mean and SD from Table 1 for healthy-base group; min/max from inclusion criteria ('healthy controls with age in a range of 18 to 50'); age in years
rci7_age.supporting_text: "healthy controls with age in a range of 18 to 50 were included" ; Table 1: Healthy-base group Age 28.83 ± 9.19
